frase_clave: Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.
reflexion: Jesus calls you today in the midst of your daily routine. Do not make excuses or wait for the perfect moment: trust in Him, take the step, and let yourself be transformed by His love.

escenas.descripcion: Jesus walks along the sunlit shore of the Sea of Galilee, warmly watching Peter and Andrew casting their net into the calm waters.
Jesus reaches out His hand invitingly toward Peter and Andrew, who leave their fishing nets on the beach to follow Him with joy.
Jesus calls James and Juan as they mend nets in a wooden boat beside their father Zebedee, who watches fondly as his sons step out to follow the Lord.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Matthew.
texto_evangelio: At that time, walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen. He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.” They immediately left their nets and followed him. Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them. They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

frase_es: Seguidme, y os haré pescadores de hombres.
reflexion_es: Jesús te llama hoy en medio de tu rutina diaria. No pongas excusas ni esperes al momento perfecto: confía en Él, da el paso y déjate transformar por su amor.
